statement: Given a circle \((O, R)\) and a point \(P\) inside with \(OP = d < R\). Consider all cyclic quadrilaterals \(ABCD\) inscribed in \((O)\) such that \(AC \perp BD\) at \(P\). Find the maximum and minimum values of the perimeter of \(ABCD\) in terms of \(R\) and \(d\).

Let \(n > 1\) be an integer not divisible by 1997. Define \(a_m = m + \dfrac{mn}{1997}\) for \(m = 1, 2, \ldots, 1996\) and \(b_m = m + \dfrac{1997m}{n}\) for \(m = 1, 2, \ldots, n-1\). Arrange both sequences in ascending order to form \(c_1 \leq c_2 \leq \cdots \leq c_{1995+n}\). Prove that \(c_{k+1} - c_k < 2\) for all \(k = 1, 2, \ldots, 1994+n\).

Find the number of functions \(f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}\) satisfying:\\
i) \(f(1) = 1\);\\
ii) \(f(n)f(n+2) = f^2(n+1) + 1997\) for every \(n \in \mathbb{N}\).

Let \(k = \sqrt[3]{3}\).\\
a) Find all polynomials \(p(x)\) with rational coefficients of minimum possible degree such that \(p(k+k^2) = 3+k\).\\
b) Does there exist a polynomial \(p(x)\) with integer coefficients satisfying \(p(k+k^2) = 3+k\)?
Prove that for every positive integer \(n\), there exists a positive integer \(k\) such that \(2^n \mid 19^k - 97\).
In the unit cube, 75 points are given with no three collinear. Prove that there exists a triangle with vertices among these 75 points whose area does not exceed \(\dfrac{7}{72}\).
